mechanismEvidence.scope: Passive ipsilateral linkage; not Drosophila coefficient calibration
Weak frequency coupling and haltere loading; no fitted coefficients transferred
Active haltere muscle control changes sensory/wing motor output; not a calibration of this observer

limits: Same-side native roll is a kinematic proxy for thoracic transmission, not measured thorax strain.
Constructed native beam frames and receptor orientations are uncalibrated priors.
All numerical mechanical coefficients and current sensitivity are explicit assumptions, not optimized or fitted.
State observer has no reciprocal body-force coupling and no direct access to opposite-side motion.
Left hDVM neural silence is not repaired or hidden; actual muscle power is reported separately.
